item.title: প্রথম ছবির পর কেন দূরে সরে যান চিত্রনায়ক উদয়

item.title: এলপিজির দাম ও কমিশন বৃদ্ধি নিয়ে চলছে শুনানি

item.title: রংপুরের পীরগঞ্জে হামলা ও লুটপাটের পূর্বে ছড়ায় পুরোনো ভিডিও

item.title: চিকিৎসা খরচ মেটাতে গিয়ে সংকটে ৪২ শতাংশ মানুষ

item.title: অর্থনীতি ধ্বংসের মুখে পড়তে পারে বলে মন্তব্য মাহবুব উল্লাহর

item.title: লক্ষ্মীপুরে গুলি করে হত্যা করা হয় খোরশেদ আলমকে

item.title: আরব জোটের ইঙ্গিত: নেতানিয়াহুকে ক্ষমতাচ্যুত করতে বিরোধীদের সাথে ঐক্যের সম্ভাবনা

item.title: ম্যাগবার্গের বিপক্ষে জয় পেল বায়ার্ন, কেনের সম্মাননা ও কোম্পানির সুস্থতা উদযাপন

item.title: আটান্ন বছর বয়সে পেশাদার ক্রিকেটকে বিদায় জানালেন আইরিশ লেগস্পিনার বেন হোয়াইট

item.title: জাতীয় বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের আগামী ৭ নভেম্বরের অনার্স দ্বিতীয় বর্ষের পরীক্ষা স্থগিত
item.description: অনিবার্য কারণবশত জাতীয় বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের আগামী ৭ নভেম্বর নির্ধারিত অনার্স দ্বিতীয় বর্ষের পরীক্ষা স্থগিত করা হয়েছে। পরবর্তীতে পরীক্ষার নতুন তারিখ জানানো হবে।

item.title: জিডিএআইয়ের প্রকাশিত ভারতীয় গেমিং প্রতিবেদনে আর্থিক সহায়তার ওপর গুরুত্ব আরোপ

item.title: আন্দামান সাগরে লঘুচাপ সৃষ্টি, অন্ধ্রপ্রদেশে প্রভাব পড়ার আশঙ্কা প্রকাশ আবহাওয়া অফিসের
item.description: ঘূর্ণিঝড় অর্নাবের পর আন্দামান সাগরে গঠিত লঘুচাপটি আগামী ৩১ অক্টোবরের মধ্যে গভীর নিম্নচাপে রূপ নিতে পারে বলে জানিয়েছে ভারতীয় আবহাওয়া বিভাগ।

item.title: Spain Mourns Dead After Second Rail Disaster on Same Track in Months
item.description: Spain is grieving the victims of a deadly train crash, marking the second major accident on this railway within nine months. The incident has intensified scrutiny regarding current spending on rail infrastructure upkeep.

item.title: Kerala Leaders Criticize Airlines Over High Fares Facing Non-Resident Citizens
item.description: During the assembly session, Kerala's Chief Minister and Opposition Leader condemned carriers for overcharging expatriates. Meanwhile, the opposition staged a walkout citing neglected benefits and the disbanding of the Loka Kerala Sabha.

item.title: কাইলি জেনারের নতুন বার্বি স্টাইল মেকআপ লুক তৈরির সহজ নিয়ম
item.description: গোলাপি আইশ্যাডো, রোমান্টিক ব্লাশ এবং গ্লসি ঠোঁটের মাধ্যমে কাইলি জেনার তার সাম্প্রতিক ট্রেন্ডি মেকআপে একটি মিষ্টি ও মায়াবী রূপ ফুটিয়ে তুলেছেন। ঘরে বসেই এই আকর্ষণীয় সাজটি অনায়াসে তৈরি করা সম্ভব।

item.title: Compact Kiosks Transform Chennai's Coffee Drinking Habits
item.description: Small coffee bars are expanding throughout Chennai, benefiting from reduced overhead costs and cheaper rent. These minimalist spots are altering local coffee consumption through novel brews, affordable rates, and engaging baristas.

item.title: গাজার শিশু চিকিৎসার্থে দেড় কোটি টাকার বেশি তহবিল সংগ্রহ করলেন হামজা
item.description: নুজুম স্পোর্টসের সহযোগিতায় একটি চ্যারিটি ইভেন্টের আয়োজন করে গাজার শিশুদের চিকিৎসার জন্য দেড় কোটি টাকার বেশি অনুদান সংগ্রহ করেছেন ফুটবলার হামজা চৌধুরী।

item.title: Methods Behind Bolsonaro's Departure to the United States
item.description: Reports detail the strategies used by Jair Bolsonaro to relocate to the US, involving decoy tactics, a private aircraft, and assistance from Donald Trump.

item.title: Eleven Detained in Bengaluru Following Software Engineers' Abduction
item.description: Police in Bengaluru have taken eleven individuals into custody for abducting two technology professionals. Additionally, one of the rescued engineers faces allegations of committing rape.

item.title: Assessing Moscow's Limited Financial Appeal for African Nations
item.description: African governments are evaluating diplomatic partnerships with Moscow, noting that Russia provides fewer financial advantages compared to Western nations and China.

item.title: Sydney Thunder opens season with strong win led by Voll
item.description: Sydney Thunder secured a comfortable season-opening victory, chasing down the target with three overs remaining thanks to an impactful bowling performance by Voll.

item.title: High Court issues rule over appointing judges as secretaries
item.description: The High Court bench of Justices Md. Tauhid Inam and Mahmud Hasan issued a rule on Thursday following an initial hearing on a petition challenging the legality of appointing three judges as private secretaries to ministers and state ministers.

item.title: Odisha plans airlift operations amid severe flooding
item.description: Authorities in Odisha are preparing to airlift individuals trapped by floodwaters following torrential downpours. Ganjam district recorded over 50 cm of rain within a 24-hour span at stations in Patrapur and Sorada.

item.title: Court denies Richard Sackler attempt to protect property
item.description: A judge dismissed a request by Richard Sackler to protect a residence connected to a multibillion-dollar opioid settlement. The property remains tied to the $7.4 billion agreement.

item.title: Dundee United midfield questioned after Celtic draw
item.description: Following a draw against reigning champions Celtic in Glasgow, discussions have arisen regarding the strength of Dundee United's midfield trio compared to others in Scotland.

item.title: One Nation claims Albanese tried to influence MP with staff offer
item.description: Pauline Hanson stated that Prime Minister Anthony Albanese improperly offered a $200,000-salary adviser to One Nation MP David Farley. The party accused the prime minister of attempting to exert political influence.

item.title: Study shows high percentage of population faces medical debt
item.description: A Health Economics Unit study reveals that roughly 42 percent of the population encounters financial difficulties when covering medical bills. In 2022, treatment costs drove 7.2 million individuals into poverty.

item.title: Court rules in favor of Prairie Lake access in property dispute
item.description: An appeals court resolved a long-standing Minnesota property dispute on Monday by upholding access rights for the Blackwood Trust. The decision also sets aside a previous $148,000 trespassing penalty.

item.title: Sanrio Drops TV Collaboration Following Chinese Internet Outrage
item.description: The company behind Hello Kitty issued an apology after facing angry responses from Chinese internet users over its collaboration with a Japanese television program.

item.title: Madhya Pradesh Tragedy: Six Dead After Sisters Jump Into Wells
item.description: Two sisters in Madhya Pradesh, one of whom was eight months pregnant, died on Wednesday alongside four children after jumping into separate wells. Relatives alerted authorities following the incident.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh Rail Services Disrupted Due to Flooded Bridge
item.description: Rising waters from Cyclone Arnab submerged a railway bridge near Ichchapuram, leading to service cancellations and reroutings. Authorities arranged a special service between Visakhapatnam and Palasa for affected travelers.

item.title: Neymar Receives Two-Match Ban Following Sports Tribunal Ruling
item.description: The ex-Brazil skipper was disciplined by a sports tribunal after covering his mouth during a dispute following a red card against Bahia.

item.title: Cyclone Arnab Set to Weaken as Odisha and Andhra Affected
item.description: Heavy rains from cyclonic storm Arnab have impacted 17 southern districts in Odisha. Meanwhile, Andhra Pradesh reported five fatalities as the Chief Minister declared compensation measures.

item.title: Hacktivists Leak Data of Over 41,000 Homeland Security Workers
item.description: A group of hackers obtained and published records belonging to border officers and ICE personnel from the Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: Congress Urged to Look Beyond Vote Theft Campaign Against Modi
item.description: Political analysts suggest the Congress party and opposition allies should adjust their approach regarding accusations of vote manipulation to better address daily voter concerns.

item.title: Delhi Building Cave-In Kills Seven Residents in Satya Niketan
item.description: The September 6 collapse of a five-story structure in Delhi claimed seven lives, highlighting dangerous living conditions for students seeking cheap housing. The disaster underscored severe shortages in safe, affordable accommodations.

item.title: West Indies Responds With Half-Century After Bangladesh Posting 272
item.description: Bangladesh was dismissed for 272 runs on the second morning, anchored by a century from Shadman Islam. In response, a half-century from Campbell guided the West Indies' batting reply.

item.title: Chief Minister Grants Compensation to Families of Accident Victims
item.description: CM Rekha Gupta distributed monetary relief to relatives of a deceased COVID-19 worker. Funds also went to households impacted by a structural collapse, a fire incident, and a drain drowning.

item.title: VHP Asks Opposition to Cancel Nov 1 Rally and Spare Hindu Festivals
item.description: The Vishva Hindu Parishad urged political opponents to call off a November 1 protest. This followed a trader demonstration in New Delhi requesting the Congress party to delay the event past Diwali.

item.title: Family Struggles With Medical Debt After Teen's Emergency Surgery
item.description: Toma Akter fell ill with severe stomach pain on September 19 and received treatment at multiple medical facilities. Her relatives faced heavy financial burdens to cover mounting hospital expenses.

item.title: Delhi traders flag potential impact on 21 markets from INDIA bloc’s November 1 rally, seek postponement
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, It projected that the November 1 rally could bring commercial activity across Old Delhi to a standstill, resulting in losses of up to ₹10,000 crore. Key points: Delhi, November, Old Delhi, delhi.

item.title: Prime Minister Tours Japanese Automotive Plant During Official Trip
item.description: Tarique Rahman traveled to Nagoya on Thursday to tour Toyota's Motomachi manufacturing facility. The prime minister and his wife Zubaida Rahman inspected the plant during their four-day journey.

item.title: Examining Jose Mourinho's Legacy at Real Madrid
item.description: Recent victories have sparked discussions regarding the Real Madrid manager's tactical reputation. Observers debate whether the coach has been unfairly evaluated compared to his peers.

item.title: Brisbane Pub Shooting Claims Life of Teenage Woman
item.description: Nineteen-year-old Vana-Reese Schuster-Togiatau sustained fatal injuries in a drive-by attack outside a southern Brisbane venue on Saturday. Law enforcement authorities are currently exploring potential organized crime connections.

item.title: Cyclone Arnab Triggers Cancellation of Dozens of Train Services
item.description: Rail authorities called off 64 train trips scheduled for October 27 and 28 due to the storm. Affected routes include express lines linking Telangana to coastal regions in Andhra Pradesh and Odisha.

item.title: Delhi Police Authorizes INDIA Alliance Rally With Specific Mandates
item.description: Authorities in Delhi permitted the opposition coalition's November 1 demonstration under strict guidelines. Officials noted they received no separate application for a mock impeachment event.

item.title: Regional Security Framework Proposed to Counter US-Israel Actions
item.description: Arab nations need to challenge Israeli dominance and establish a security network free from American influence to halt ongoing conflicts.

item.title: Rajinikanth Starrer Jailer 2 Approaches Rs 500 Crore Domestic Box Office
item.description: The action film featuring Rajinikanth and directed by Nelson is nearing the Rs 500 crore gross milestone in India by its fifteenth day in theaters.
